items.title: Copper Heads for Weekly Loss as Doubts on US Tariffs Intensify
items.description: Copper headed for its first weekly loss since June on concern the US is pushing back a decision on whether to impose import tariffs.

items.title: Bearish Bets Build in Short India Bonds as Cash Drain Looms
items.description: Bets against India’s short-term bonds are rising, with traders wagering that yields will go up on the central bank’s efforts to drain excess cash from the banking system.

items.title: Japan’s Producer Price Gains Stay Elevated, Backing BOJ Hikes
items.description: Prices for Japan’s corporate goods rose at a faster pace than expected in August, supporting the case for the Bank of Japan to keep raising interest rates to stem upside inflation risks.

items.title: China Halts New Battery Factories on Capacity Concerns: Caixin
items.description: China has temporarily suspended construction of new projects to manufacture power and energy-storage batteries, pending a year-end review of industry capacity, Caixin reported.

items.title: Global Bond Selloff Sends 10-Year Treasury Yields to Cusp of 5%
items.description: Bond bears are pushing benchmark Treasury yields toward the closely-watched 5% level ahead of US inflation data that stands to determine expectations for a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike next week

items.title: Xi’s First India Trip Since 2019 Extends an Olive Branch to Modi
items.description: Chinese President Xi Jinping will visit India to attend the BRICS summit and likely meet with Prime Minister Narendra Modi on the sidelines. Bloomberg's Swati Pandey reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Edmond de Rothschild Says Buy Yen Dips as Carry Trade Unwinds
items.description: The yen’s recent rally marks the beginning of a broader correction in the currency’s long-running undervaluation, according to Edmond de Rothschild Asset Management.

items.title: SoftBank Rally Raises Short Squeeze Risk After Bearish Bets Jump
items.description: SoftBank Group’s recent rally exposes risks for investors with short positions that have risen to a one-year high.

items.title: Gold Set for Weekly Drop as Oil, Inflation Boost Rate-Hike Bets
items.description: Gold was on track for a third weekly decline, as surging oil prices and the latest US inflation report bolstered the case for the Federal Reserve to hike interest rates next week.

items.title: Australia Bond Yields Jump to Highest Since 2011 on Oil Concerns
items.description: Australian bonds slid, tracking an overnight slump in Treasuries after escalating Middle East tensions drove up oil prices and fueled concerns about inflation.

items.title: Peru Holds Key Rate as Central Bank Sees Inflation Easing
items.description: Peru left borrowing costs unchanged for a 12th straight month as policymakers bet that the recent inflation spike will prove temporary.

items.title: Asian Stocks, Bonds Drop on Oil, Inflation Concern: Markets Wrap
items.description: Asian stocks and bonds fell after a surge in oil prices sparked a selloff in US markets, while the latest inflation data reinforced bets on an imminent Federal Reserve interest-rate hike.

items.title: Bessent Dismisses Buyback Concern, Says Treasuries Strong
items.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent dismissed concerns about the US bond market after Thursday’s smaller-than-expected debt buyback operation sent yields to multi-year highs.
